1. SCENARIO
Imagine you are playing GTA V and driving a sports car at 55 m/s. You start at your garage, speed across the city to a mission marker, and then drive back to the same garage. Your game's "Total Distance Traveled" stat in the pause menu increases continuously throughout the entire trip. Even when you return to the garage, that counter shows a large positive number because it tracked every meter of the road you covered. However, if you check the mini-map, the straight-line gap between your current position and your starting point is now zero. The stat tracks your journey, while the map tracks your net change in position
